conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Office of Compliance. This is Federal Investigator George Thompson. Who am I speaking with?
Hi, this is Ravi Patel. I got a message to call this number about my business taxes?
Mr. Patel, I see your file here. We have identified a critical issue with your payroll tax filings and non-compliance with IRS 1099 requirements for the last two quarters. This is extremely serious.
Oh, I'm, I'm sorry, I thought everything was submitted. What's wrong with my filings?
According to our audit, you failed to submit multiple required payroll forms and underreported taxable income for your contractors. This has triggered a federal review of your business account.
This must be a mistake. I use an accountant for all my taxes.

Mr. Patel, this is a federal investigation. If you do not resolve this immediately, your business license may be revoked, and you could face asset seizure. We have already started preparing a formal enforcement action.
Wait, please, don't do that! I'm on a work visa, if this affects my business, I could lose my status. What do I need to do?
You are at risk of a full-scale audit and federal charges for tax evasion. However, you are eligible to settle the balance today to prevent escalation. You must follow my instructions exactly.
Yes, please, I'll do anything. What is the balance? How do I pay?

The total outstanding liability is $7,400, including penalties. Immediate payment is required via wire transfer or cryptocurrency. I will provide the wire routing information or digital wallet address.
Crypto? I've never paid taxes that way before. Is this normal?
This is a special compliance method for urgent tax delinquency cases. If you do not comply, an arrest warrant will be issued against you and reported to immigration authorities.
Please, I can't have trouble with immigration. Can I pay with my bank account?
You may use bank transfer, but the funds must clear within one hour. I will remain on the line while you prepare the transaction. Do you have access to your banking app now?
Yes, I have it on my phone.
Good. I will now provide the wire routing number. Write this down and confirm when you are ready for the account details.
Okay, I'm ready. Please tell me.

Routing number: 028919382. Account: IRS Compliance Settlement, account number 772314885. You must send $7,400 immediately. If your bank blocks the transfer, inform them this is a government-ordered transaction.
This is so much money. Can I pay part now and the rest later?
Partial payments are not permitted in federal violation cases. Failure to transmit the full amount will result in the immediate suspension of your business and a criminal referral.
I don't have that much in my account right now. What can I do?

Listen to me carefully. Go to your nearest convenience store and purchase $3,000 in Apple or Google Play gift cards. The remaining balance can be sent via bank transfer. I will stay on the phone with you while you do this.
Gift cards? Why do I have to do that? It sounds strange.
This is a federal protocol for urgent tax settlements. Do not question these instructions. Any delay will be recorded as non-compliance and will be used in your case summary.
Okay, okay, I'll go now. Should I take my phone with me?
Yes. Do not disconnect this call under any circumstance. I need you to confirm the gift card codes as soon as you purchase them or the case will escalate.
I'm leaving right now. Please don't report me to immigration.
As long as you comply fully, this matter will remain confidential. Get the gift cards and notify me as soon as you have them.
